artifacts.name: 1st - Two Fates
artifacts.desc_en: This is Celeste’s ultimate and the main reason she is so unique. It allows her to switch between Light Form and Dark Form. In Dark Form, she creates a large flame in the enemy team that blocks healing. In Light Form, she heals the weakest ally for 5 seconds. Without this skill, Celeste cannot change forms, so she loses her main power. Another special trait of this skill is that Celeste is the only hero in Hero Wars: Dominion Era who needs just 50% of her energy bar (instead of the usual 100%) to activate her ultimate. This means she can switch forms more frequently than any other hero, constantly balancing healing and anti-healing effects during battle. Formula: Dark – Healing Block: (70% Mag. atk. + Ivl * 350) | Light – Heal: (70% Mag. atk. + Ivl * 100) over 5s .

skins.priority: Высокий – Identical stat value to Cybernetic Skin. Offers more durability and better synergy with healing abilities, but you can delay this one if you already maxed another Здоровье skin.

skins.name: Demonic Skin
skins.priority: Средний-Высокий – Boosts Ziri’s physical урон reduction, which supports her Танк role especially when using her taunt skill. Prioritize after Здоровье-based skins.

skins.name: Romantic Skin
skins.priority: Средний – Useful only against magic-heavy teams. Since Ziri’s base Защита от Магии is already Высокий and her taunt boosts it further, this is less urgent overall.

glyphs.name: 4th Glyph – Броня:
glyphs.desc: Raises her Броня by +6,500. Great against physical teams, especially since Ziri often taunts враги and reflects physical урон using her second skill.
glyphs.priority: Высокий – Very useful when facing strong physical урон dealers. Level this along with Защита от Магии depending on your враги.

glyphs.name: 5th Glyph – Сила:
glyphs.desc: Increases Сила by +1,135, which boosts Ziri’s Здоровье and Физическая Атака. Since she scales directly from Сила, it adds durability and slight offensive benefit.
glyphs.priority: Средний-Высокий – Not as vital as flat Здоровье or resistances, but still important for overall Танк growth. Prioritize after Здоровье, Броня, and Защита от Магии.

war_flags.name: War Flag of Fervor
war_flags.desc: This flag increases Energy Gain for Tanks by 10%, allowing Ziri to activate her skills more frequently especially her ultimate, which triggers her Броня-boosting artifact and crowd Контролёр combo.
war_flags.benefit: Ziri heavily relies on skill timing to taunt враги and protect союзники. With faster energy gain, she becomes a more consistent frontliner, offering better protection and reflection uptime for the whole team.

war_flags.name: War Flag of Recovery
war_flags.desc: This flag increases all healing by 10%, which directly benefits Ziri’s passive healing from Shelter of Sands and synergizes well with Хилер pets like Oliver.
war_flags.benefit: Since Ziri heals herself when burrowed, the additional healing increases her survivability window. It also enhances team healing effects if you pair her with supports like Thea or Martha.

war_flags.name: War Flag of Pet Strength
war_flags.desc: This flag increases Pet Skill Power by 10%, boosting the effectiveness of pet-linked healing, protection, and patronage skills. Especially useful when using Oliver or Biscuit with Ziri.
war_flags.benefit: Ziri benefits greatly from supportive pets. This flag strengthens those pet abilities, ensuring stronger shields, healing, or debuffs to assist Ziri’s Танк role.
